newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA BONDS CLOSE STRONG ON INSPIRED U.S. DEBT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA BONDS CLOSE STRONG ON INSPIRED U.S. DEBT.

text.p: 1405 GMT - South African bonds close stronger in tune with excited U.S. Treasuries. Rand drifts stronger as dollar stays weak versus mark.
* Benchmark R150 bond last at 14.03 percent from Tuesday closing rate of 14.105 pct, easily sweeping aside support at 14.08.
* Dealers say local bonds given fillip by U.S. debt which applauding as-expected U.S. July retail sales data and producer price figure which indicating no price pressures.
* Rand at 4.6585/6615 on dollar from Tuesday's late 4.6650/6680
* Dealers say carry trades and sustained move under 1.85 by dollar/mark helping otherwise torpid market.
* Dlr/mark dropped on Bundesbank report saying German consumer prices rose strongly in recent months.
